File convert · free, in your browser

Convert a PDF to Excel (XLSX)

Pull a price list, a statement or a report out of a PDF and into a spreadsheet. Text laid out in columns becomes a grid you can sort and sum.

Convert PDF to Excel

How to do it

  1. Drop the PDF on the page.
  2. PDF to Excel (XLSX) is chosen for you. Limit the pages with the Pages box if the table is on a few of them.
  3. Choose Convert.
  4. Download the .xlsx file and open it in Excel, LibreOffice or Slop Tables.

Your files stay on this device: File convert runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

How are the columns found?

Each line of the page becomes a row, and each column of text becomes a column, so tables aligned in columns turn into a grid.

Are numbers kept as numbers?

Yes. Values that read as numbers are written as numbers, so you can calculate with them straight away.

Does it keep formatting or formulas?

No. The workbook holds the values only: no images, formulas or cell formats.

Is the PDF sent anywhere?

No. The conversion runs in your browser and the workbook is saved to your device.
